blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nine Filipino athletes aged 17 and younger will represent the country at the fourth Youth Olympic Games 2026 in Dakar, Senegal, from October 31 to November 13. Philippine Olympic Committee president Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino sees the Dakar Games as a stepping stone for the country’s next generation of Olympians. “They are the future Olympians, future world champions, and the Dakar YOG will provide them the platform to follow the footsteps of the Diazes and Yulos,” he said. The Philippine delegation includes Pi Durden Wangkay in the men’s 200 meters and Naomi Marjorie Caesar in the women’s 800 meters […]...
